headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to improve how they serve the public and deliver government services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to improve the experience people have when they use government services. Its stated goal is to rebuild public trust in government. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that provide services to the public
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change how they design and deliver services to people.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal government services
who_it_affects.how: They are the intended beneficiaries of changes to how agencies serve the public.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 13, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
